rules.requirement: Activation capability is an issued exact object against a verified fresh owned fixture and exact existing Run/Case/lease/approver/beneficiary. Copied/reconstructed/wrong-DB permits, untrusted attachment, alternate owner connection and production configuration deny. No four/eight-hour default.

ACTIVATE authenticates the real API owner and current READ/PREPARE/EXECUTE plus all participants within the same verified owner transaction that writes activation event and assignment. App authentication in another transaction cannot be the authority. Owner connection is never made a general Store/user-controlled write connection.

Never overwrite even inactive legacy or isolated assignments. Native replacement is exact current lease/activation binding CAS and retains old activation history. SQL NULL differs from JSON null; unknown/mixed markers deny.

Prevent provenance downgrade: native marker clearing/removal/delete-and-legacy-reinsert must not let cold Store accept old native scope as legacy. Require durable activation provenance lookup and/or immutable assignment guard plus immutable activation history.

Trusted guarded connection at every actual use, autocommit/plain/non-guarded/shadow denial, first parent-before-Run protection and commit-time current grant/source/UTC/protocol check. Commit recheck cannot introduce first parent locks after dispatch/Case/receipt locks.

Versions must detect revoke/regrant or principal/grant reconstruction, including tables without explicit revision. Bind reliable row generation/identity and approver READ generation; restoring active fields must not resurrect the old approval/lease.

Activation append/event/assignment is atomic with exact event ID/request key/strict DTO fingerprint, approved decision receipt hash/revision, lease ID, target, tenant, source and UTC interval. Failure at either event/assignment/final recheck rolls back all.

Approval decision receipts remain immutable NON_EFFECTIVE. Current access comes from separate trusted activation plus exact durable binding, current protocol APPROVED and original lease; REVOKE/expired/new request or lease replacement denies old native binding without automatic mutation/rebind.

Exclude Case state from stable READ source equality: legal lifecycle progression, cancellation/reconciliation and local closure preserve otherwise currently authorized historical READ. New ACTIVATE rejects business-frozen/locally closed Case. Existing business write guards remain independent and mandatory.

Activation changes registered existing_access dependency source. Keep explicit local_revision/CAS ADOPT; never repair implicitly on GET/provider. Activation source must not circularly bind the assignment collection changed by its own activation.

Original-key ACTIVATE GET returns immutable historical receipt and separate current effective state; lost response only GET original key. Expiry/revoke/cold unauthorized state never reinstalls assignment or shows historical activation as currently effective.

Permit UTC interval is explicit and no wider than approved lease and issuer fixture lifetime. Check database clock after waits and immediately before completion, including actual business commit; future start is not yet effective and expired permit cannot reactivate an old lease.

Cold Store has no trusted effective access. Explicit same-scope trusted rebind must prove the same fixture/database/permit/lease/activation immutable bytes and cannot adopt arbitrary existing JSON as a provider.

Native READ is also a prerequisite for existing independently assigned synthetic dispatch/ACCEPT/manual receipt operations; it is not only a status page. No CONTROL/EXECUTE/FILE_READ, isolated adapter execution, external delivery or new Grant follows from the assignment.
